newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 79.4 bln marks in repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 79.4 bln marks in repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it allocated 79.4 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a three percent fixed rate.
The central bank said it accepted 28.5 percent of the bids.
A repo pact for 77.9 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires Wednesday, so a net 1.5 billion marks is flowing into the market.

The Bundesbank said banks bid for 278.7 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since August 1996. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
